data.name: Mahira
data.gender_notes: Mahira is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Feminine of māhir, from the Arabic root م-ه-ر (m-h-r), 'to be skilful'. Its root is م-ه-ر (m-h-r). A common Muslim female name. Mahira is a Arabic name meaning “Skilful; expert; talented”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mahira expresses “Skilful; expert; talented”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Feminine of māhir, from the Arabic root م-ه-ر (m-h-r), 'to be skilful'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahira total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
